articles.title: How to Understand Key Terms in Large Language Models
articles.content_excerpt: When you use AI to write, read reports, or work with files, you may encounter terms such as token , context , and agent . These terms help explain what happens when you give an AI application a task: what information it can use, how it produces a response, and whether it can take actions such as searching for sources or saving a document. This guide introduces the main terms related to large language models (LLMs) through practical examples. It begins with how models process information, then explains how to give them instructions and reference material, how tools and agents carry out tasks, and how to organise ongoing work. articles.title: Afghans “Have Been the Victims” of U.S. Military, Taliban, Cartels & More for Decades: Nagieb Khaja
articles.content_excerpt: Award-winning Danish Afghan journalist and filmmaker Nagieb Khaja’s most recent documentary, Winning Heart and Minds , is an investigation into what went wrong in the U.S.-led war in Afghanistan. In the film, Khaja travels to Musa Qala, the capital of the southern Helmand province. Danish and British troops had been deployed to Musa Qala in 2006 to defend their allies, the local police, against Taliban insurgents. While urban areas benefited from U.S. occupation during the war, “Western forces allied themselves with forces that in rural Afghanistan were considered worse than the Taliban,” says Khaja. “The police forces and the warlords that were fighting side by side with American, Danish and British forces, they were drug cartels, they were ruthless criminals, they were rapists.”

articles.title: The war against Iran and the dialectics of resistance
articles.author: Prabhat Patnaik
articles.content_excerpt: There is a dialectics of aggression and also a dialectics of resistance involved here. Imperialism was emboldened to attack Iran because of the relative ease with which it carried out its operations in Venezuela; and had the regime change in Iran occurred as easily as imperialism had imagined, then it would have been further emboldened to carry its attacks immediately to other countries. But the resistance in Iran, which came as a big surprise for it, has stopped it in its tracks for the time being. articles.title: Costa Rican foreign minister dismissed after president misses ‘Shield of Americas’ meeting in NYC
articles.author: Pablo Meriguet
articles.content_excerpt: Costa Rica’s Minister of Foreign Affairs, Manuel Tovar, was dismissed from his post last week by the country’s president Laura Fernández. Tovar was considered one of the “heavyweights” of the country’s dominant political faction, having previously served as Minister of Commerce under President Rodrigo Chávez. The decision was made by Fernández on September 24, because, according to a statement, her foreign minister failed to inform her of an invitation to a meeting held in New York City aimed at strengthening the so-called Shield of the Americas. articles.title: Brazil’s movements occupy streets across the country in defense of democracy and Lula’s candidacy
articles.author: Brasil de Fato
articles.content_excerpt: Militants and supporters of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva participated, this Sunday, September 27, in demonstrations as part of the national mobilization “Let’s go, Lula,” held a week before the first round of elections. In Rio de Janeiro, “CarnaLula 2026” spanned the length of Copacabana beach. With a microphone, PT Senate candidate Benedita da Silva spoke about the importance of Carnival as an expression of popular culture and called on those present to also vote for a progressive bloc in the Rio de Janeiro Legislative Assembly and the Federal Chamber of Deputies. She reinforced the discourse that, in this election, not only democracy is at stake, but also national sovereignty . “We will not be anyone’s backyard,” she repeated Lula’s phrase.
